expect_red: a joint end with a candidate list mirrors as a row with a twisty in front: the twisty toggles, the row still selects, the list shows only when open, and its words wrap

mutations.contract: In the shell's nav a joint end with a list keeps its own click (select) and opens the list only from the twisty in front of it.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_joint_end_lists_its_candidate_faces_and_says_why_each_is_there (2026-11-03). Drawing a twisty row as the ordinary <details> disclosure is the natural-looking shape and takes the row's select away: a click on the end would only open its list.
